name: Time before its date
title: Time before its date: a task whose notes say it is due soon says how much free time is left before that date on your calendar, and puts focus time there in one press

events.found: You pressed Find time on a task due soon, and saw the free time left before its date
events.blocked: You pressed Block it, and focus time for the task went on your calendar

permissions: reads the task's notes for a date something is due by in the next three weeks
reads your main calendar from now to that date, only when you press Find time
puts Google's own focus time on your main calendar only when you press Block it; Google declines new invitations then and sets Chat to do not disturb
touches.remove: Turn the switch task_time off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: no section is drawn and the route refuses.
